headline: Contra's fortress guns can finally be shot down
lede: The base gate's cannon housings now obey the arms-depot law: ten aimed rounds cave each one with a spark-per-hit build to a named blast, and the wreck stops eating rounds — muzzle light out, soot ring on, smoke rising. The shuttered core stays the only way to clear the stage, exactly like the 1987 cabinet's flow.

notes.text: CONTRA #2880 (never-dry POLISH stage): per-housing hp/dead ride stateHash; caved guns are silent for the fight; wrecks let rifle and laser through; live armour + the gate pierce law verbatim. contracheck 147/147 with 5 sim pins + 2 browser legs (soot-ring pixel delta), mutants 19/19 named red.

DOUBLE DRAGON shipped twice in parallel: yard cast law #2877 (swaying pools, leaning shadows, swarf + leaking-drum dressing) and chain scoring #2882 (consecutive KOs pay up to x4, ~3s window, HUD xN tag).
Prod verify recipe updated: the site 308-redirects (curl -L) and games bundle into shared index-*.js chunks — crawl the asset graph and grep the marker anywhere, per-game chunk names are gone.
idle-detection lesson (#1782 watch): both slots got warden kicks while alive mid-suite. A quiet issue is not a dead lane — age the newest checkpoint AND the slot port before killing.
